text.tspan: On-Demand g4dn → g6 → g5, Spot last
LOD tiles · read via the API
ALB redeems the code and validates the session
viewer loads detections and LOD tiles through the API
Sign-in, before step 1: every ALB rule requires a Cognito session; /api also requires the SPA's header
KEDA aws-sqs-queue scaler: ApproximateNumberOfMessages, visible + in-flight, target 2 per pod → worker Deployment 0–10
Cluster Autoscaler (priority expander) adds GPU nodes for Pending GPU pods: On-Demand g4dn.xlarge, g6.xlarge,
g5.xlarge and g6.2xlarge pools first, then a Spot g5 / g4dn pool; each pool scales from 0, up to 10 nodes in total
No-domain option: ACCESS_MODE=port-forward deploys no ALB and no Cognito; users reach the UI and API with kubectl port-forward.
